faq.registerQ: How do I register for a tournament?
faq.registerA: Open the page of the tournament you're interested in and press “Register”. Once you submit the form, the organisers receive your application and will contact you if needed.
faq.accountQ: Do I need an account to register?
faq.accountA: Yes — applying to a tournament and tracking its status requires a MyDebate account. It also lets you save tournaments and see your participation history.
faq.noTeamQ: Can I take part without a team?
faq.noTeamA: That depends on the individual tournament. Organisers state the format (team or individual) in the event description — check the “Format” section on the tournament page.
faq.statusQ: How do I know my application was accepted?
faq.statusA: The status is shown under “My tournaments” in your profile. As soon as the organiser decides, you get a notification on the platform.
faq.editQ: Can I change my details after applying?
faq.editA: Contact the tournament organiser directly using the details on the event page — they can adjust your application manually.
faq.paidQ: Is there a fee to take part?
faq.paidA: The organiser sets the entry fee, and it is shown on each tournament's page. Some events on the platform are free.
faq.whoPublishesA: Any registered user can publish a tournament — after your first publication passes moderation, your account gets the “Organiser” status.
